versions.changelog: v1.0.2: Removed hardcoded credentials; load secrets from external file/env; added secret-scan script.

- Updated package metadata in package.json.
- No changes to skill functionality or documentation.

Initial release of email-tool skill.

- Send emails via Zoho with support for to, cc, bcc, subject, and HTML/plain text body.
- Search inbox emails with customizable queries, result limits, and optional mark-as-read.
- Uses hardcoded Zoho email account credentials for configuration.
